title: Macaroni Pie
description: Macaroni Pie is a dish from Barbados featuring macaroni, all-purpose flour, whole cow milk, cheddar cheese. This home-sized recipe records each ingredient at the step where it is used.

steps.instruction: Cook the pasta in generously salted boiling water for about 12 minutes until al dente; reserve a cup of its starchy water.
Melt the fat, stir in flour and cook gently for about 9 minutes, then whisk in liquid to create a smooth thickened sauce.
Combine the listed ingredients in a bowl until evenly mixed; avoid overworking delicate components.
Layer the previously prepared components evenly inside a baking dish, serving mold or plate appropriate to the recipe; smooth the surface and avoid mixing the layers.
Bake the shaped or assembled mixture in a preheated oven for about 33 minutes until set and cooked through.
